title: MT-MIA (Finding Connections: Membership Inference Attacks for the Multi-Table Synthetic Data Setting)
summary: Official implementation of a research paper studying membership inference attacks against multi-table synthetic data generators such as ClavaDDPM, RealTabFormer, and RelDiff. Its ClavaDDPM baseline pipeline builds SDV MultiTableMetadata/SingleTableMetadata objects, trains a CTGANSynthesizer baseline, and evaluates synthetic fidelity with SDV's evaluate_quality and sdmetrics QualityReport/DiagnosticReport, so SDV is run both as a baseline synthesizer and as the fidelity-evaluation engine.
evidence: ClavaDDPM/baseline_utils.py:140 uses CTGANSynthesizer.fit/sample; gen_multi_report.py imports sdv.evaluation evaluate_quality
